summary: Cancelled sales order S00021: clicking the statusbar "Cancel" button opened an in-page Odoo confirmation wizard ("Cancel Sales Order" heading, alert text "Are you sure you want to cancel this order?", with Send and cancel / Cancel / Discard buttons — no native browser confirm fired, so the armed dialog handler was not needed). After closing an unrelated "Edit: customer" modal with Escape, I clicked the wizard's "Cancel" button, which cancelled the order. Verified after an F5 reload: the statusbar shows "Cancelled" as the current checked stage (Cancelled / Sales Order / Quotation Sent / Quotation) and a "Set to Quotation" button is offered, so S00021 is no longer an active order; reference S00021 and customer fwod103-luna-n1 Bench Customer (Benchville) unchanged.
